company.shortDescription: PraxiLabs is an e-learning company that developed a product that makes virtual science labs accessible.
company.description:
PraxiLabs is an e-learning company that developed a product that makes virtual science labs accessible. The company aims to provide equal opportunity for enhanced STEM education for students everywhere by providing 3D interactive virtual simulations that are accessible, usable, and affordable for educational institutions and students.

PraxiLabs was founded in 2016 and headquartered in Al Qahirah, Egypt.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform offering interactive 3D virtual science experiments in biology, chemistry, and physics for educational institutions.
